seen.body:
Contract: docs/specs/ledger.md, Authority and topology.
Every non-primary target is one-way: pull ignores its edits (optionally flags a state edit as a divergence); `qew mirror add FORGE REPO [--read-only]`, `qew mirror remove TARGET`, `qew mirror list` edit config.
Scenarios (each a named walk whose docstring states the failure it prevents):
- golden: edit on a secondary mirror is not imported
- golden: mirror add/list/remove round trip leaves other config untouched
- refusal: removing the primary is refused
seen.title: Secondary mirrors are read-only and qew mirror add/remove/list
